header: Three customers on what the event data changed

case_studies_items.quote: We shipped the same onboarding for two years without knowing where it lost people. Step three turned out to be the answer, and fixing it took activation from 34% to 58%.

metrics.description: Up from 34% before the March 2024 rebuild

case_studies_items.quote: Support kept escalating a checkout bug nobody could reproduce. The session trail showed a 14-second wait on card validation, and the ticket queue dropped by a third that week.

metrics.title: Checkout support tickets
metrics.description: Measured over the eight weeks after the fix
